rule.note: T4 from backtest run 2. Technical voter only: RSI 14, MACD 12/26/9, Bollinger 20/2, majority of the three. The vote is read on the last 500 closed 15-minute bars, every 4 hours. UP and DOWN only; sideways is not a call. Entry is the next 1-minute open. Exit is the open 4 hours later. One position at a time. Funding is applied.
